coordinate_system: glTF local coordinates: metres, Y-up. Blender editable source: Z-up. Pivot_position is local translation relative to named parent.
rotation_convention: Right-handed local Euler degrees; limb/hatch bends X, vertical-door yaw Y. Translation ranges are offsets from rest position.

movable_nodes.name: loading_door_lift
movable_nodes.note: Existing segmented face is one rigid lift assembly, not a deforming roll-up shutter. +local Y lifts vertically; travel limited to keep the panel inside the visual envelope.

movable_nodes.name: pedestrian_door_hinge
movable_nodes.note: Hinge along left vertical edge. Positive local Y opens outward. Dark shallow doorway backing, not a modeled walkable interior.

notes: No skeletal rig, skin weights or baked clips; static nodes are intentional.
Palette factors are linear-RGB multiplicative tint, not arbitrary exact RGB replacement of colored texture pixels.
For independently tinted spawned instances, clone the instance material objects before editing factors; never mutate a shared loader-cache material. Maps remain immutable and may be shared.
Reduced LODs preserve original geometry/texture resolutions; each LOD is a standalone alternative, not loaded simultaneously.
